violation_type.title: Space Requirements for School-age - Individual Activities (26 TAC §746.2703(2))
violation_type.short_title: Space Requirements for School-age - Individual Activities
violation_type.typical_finding: The school age children were observed napping on the floor with no nap equipment.

finding_variants.text: The school age children were observed napping on the floor with no nap equipment.
During inspection there was a child doing activities in an area where he could easily be unnoticed. This was corrected during inspection when the child was told to conduct his activities elsewhere.
